title: Reinhardt's conjecture
exact_target: Is Reinhardt’s octagon with hyperbolically rounded corners the unique shape, up to affine changes, whose densest packing has the smallest density among centrally symmetric convex planar bodies?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7200029 (AMR-071-0029). CC BY 4.0.
Thomas C. Hales, On the Reinhardt conjecture (2011). Abstract and Section 1, pp. 1–2.
